clues.label: Tagline
clues.value: “▇▇▇ has 23 distinct personalities. The 24th is about to be unleashed.”

clues.label: Plot
clues.value: Though ▇▇▇ has evidenced 23 personalities to his trusted psychiatrist, Dr. ▇▇▇, there remains one still submerged who is set to materialize and dominate all the others. Compelled to abduct three teenage girls led by the willful, observant ▇▇▇, ▇▇▇ reaches a war for survival among all of those contained within him — as well as everyone around him — as the walls between his compartments shatter apart.
